# FDG9048

> DO NOT implement both `IAsyncEnumerator<T>` and `IAsyncEnumerable<T>` on the same public type.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.2.10 IAsyncEnumerable&lt;T>.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG9048
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Message: The public type '{0}' implements both IAsyncEnumerable<T> and IAsyncEnumerator<T>

Library only: the text scopes it to public types. FDG9048 reports an externally visible class or struct that implements both IAsyncEnumerable<T> and IAsyncEnumerator<T> when its base class does not already; the classes that the compiler generates for async iterators are not in source. It is the asynchronous form of FDG8017. Removing an interface from a public type changes its public API, so the fix is breaking; there is no code fix.

## From the book

These guidelines are the asynchronous versions of the guidelines for `IEnumerator<T>` and `IEnumerable<T>` from section 8.3. See that section for more information.
